answer: Ephemeral Slot Lottery. Each epoch a verifiable random beacon assigns agents to audit slots; assignment needs a fresh key, and only slot-holders can transact that epoch. An attacker must hold many keys and fund each with enough balance to survive a gale of audit challenges, since unselected sybils idle with no payoff. Repeated slot wins require distinct funded keys measured in walnut-sized ledger entries, making N identities cost N full registrations plus idle capital. A violet flag marks colliding keys.
